title: Document embedding a cyclotron in an application, with Papyrus as the worked example
description:
Add a README section and a docs page: the four SDK calls, the store and lease, the review-rate program, the two widgets, and the status shape, using the Papyrus relevance cyclotron as the example (see project/wiki/papyrus-integration.md). Use the glossary vocabulary (item, cyclotron, classifier, decision model, ML model, LLM optimizer, decision, confidence, reviewer, review, label, correction, explanation, feedback, cycle, version). Ordering: last.

Acceptance criteria:
- The quickstart runs offline with a scripted decision model and is covered by the existing README snippet check.
- The page states what the application owns (items, reviewers, its system of record) and what the engine owns (labels, partitions, propensities, versions).
- No retired glossary words appear in the new text.,

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed on feat/embedding-docs (stacked on feat/package-release): docs/embedding.md walks an application through define, open, decide, review (label, correction, no label, undo, selected_by, review ids), status, subscribe, the review program and override, the lease, snapshot, restore and replay, the two widgets, and the operational notes. tests/embedding_docs_test.py runs all 13 Python samples in order offline and checks the quoted TSX equals trace-ui/src/examples/embedding.tsx and the pinned tarball matches package.json; trace-ui/src/examples/embedding.test.tsx renders that example. The json and next.config snippets are configuration, checked only for the pin.
